title: Spatial and single-nucleus transcriptomics reveals the molecular pathology of type 2 diabetes-associated cognitive dysfunction.
publicationName: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
journalName: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
snippet: The mechanisms underlying type 2 diabetes-associated cognitive dysfunction (DACD) remain poorly understood, hindering therapeutic progress. Here, we integrated spatial transcriptomics and single-nucleus RNA sequencing to delineate the spatiotemporal molecular and cellular landscape of DACD in brain tissues from 3- and 6-mo-old mouse models.
